actions: Write down every dollar in and out for 7 days straight (notebook or notes app)
Sort last month's spending into Needs / Wants / Wealth buckets
List every recurring subscription and cancel at least one you don't use
Open a separate savings account for your pay-yourself-first habit
weeks.title: Know Your Numbers

actions: Set up an automatic transfer to savings on payday (any amount — start small)
Move two bill due dates to spread payments across the month
Build a simple cash-flow calendar: paydays in, bill dates out
Identify your thinnest week of the month and make a plan to cover it
weeks.title: Build the Foundation

actions: List 5 skills you already have that someone would pay for
Ask 5 people what they'd pay you to help them with
Write your one-page offer: who it's for, the problem, what they get, the price
Tell 10 people about your offer (text, call, or in person)
weeks.title: Find Your First Offer

actions: Rewrite your offer in outcome language (what they get, not what you do)
Pick ONE platform where your customers are and post 3 times this week
Ask your first happy customer for a review or referral
Follow up with everyone who showed interest but didn't buy
weeks.title: Get Your First Yes

actions: Open a separate bank account for business money
Set up a simple income/expense tracker for the business
Put your first 3 business receipts or invoices in one folder
Decide your reinvestment split and write it down
weeks.title: Run It Like a Business

actions: Deliver your offer to 3 paying customers (or 3 free/discounted for reviews)
Collect a testimonial from each one (text message screenshot counts)
Raise your price or tighten your offer based on what you learned
Post your testimonials where new customers can see them
weeks.title: Proof and Momentum

actions: Calculate your real monthly business profit (income minus expenses)
List what you'd fund if you had $1,000 to reinvest — in priority order
Research one local grant or small-business program and note the deadline
Talk to your bank about a business checking account or line of credit options
weeks.title: Fund the Growth

actions: Reinvest your first chunk of profit using your written split
Test one new marketing channel for two weeks and track results
Systematize your most repetitive task (a checklist, a template, a script)
Set a monthly revenue goal for the next 90 days and write it where you'll see it
weeks.title: Scale What Works

actions: Build or top up a $1,000 starter emergency fund
List your assets vs. liabilities using the pocket test from Pillar 6
If employed, check your 401(k) match — contribute enough to get all of it
Open a Roth IRA or brokerage account (funding it comes next)
weeks.title: Start Your Asset Column

actions: Set up automatic monthly investing, even a small amount
Write down your investor rules: what you'll buy, what you won't, when you'll review
Learn one investing term per day this week (index fund, expense ratio, diversification…)
Review: is your emergency fund intact? Top it up before investing more
weeks.title: Invest on Autopilot

actions: Run the cash-flow math on a real local rental listing (rent minus ALL costs)
Walk or drive one neighborhood and note 5 properties that look like opportunities
Learn your city's basic landlord-tenant rules (one evening of reading)
Talk to one local investor, agent, or landlord about how they started
weeks.title: Learn the Property Game

actions: Write your 12-month wealth vision: income, assets, and lifestyle in plain words
Pick the ONE pillar you'll go deeper on next quarter
Share your biggest win from these 90 days in the community feed
Set your next 90-day plan: 3 goals, each with a first action and a date
weeks.title: Lock In and Level Up
